title: Flynn MACJ Writing Workflow V2
purpose: A complete gated MADMAN to ARCHITECT to CARPENTER to JUDGE state machine for human and AI-assisted writing.

source_boundary.rule: Direct claims require a supplied-source locator. Applied records must identify themselves as extensions.

records.rule: Generate and collect facts, ideas, constraints, evidence, and source material without prematurely polishing.

Test every exit criterion.

actions: Clarify the assignment, desired result, and intended readers.
Estimate available time and allocate it across gathering, outlining, drafting, and judging.

actions: Write the main points as complete, specific propositions.
Use about three propositions when that compression fits, without forcing the final document to contain exactly three.
Order points according to the reader's task rather than the order of discovery.
Choose an opening, middle, and close appropriate to the purpose.
Remove irrelevant branches and identify evidence gaps.
Decide whether a graphic would materially clarify the content.
exit_criteria: Purpose and recipient gates pass.
The outline contains the evidence and ask needed for the minimum success condition.

guardrails: Prohibited shortcuts: Polishing each sentence before completing the draft.

actions: Reduce distractions and schedule a definite drafting period.
Use the outline as a guide and begin with the most tractable section if necessary.
Draft rapidly enough to preserve flow and natural idiom.
Defer line editing and perfectionism.
Move to another section when blocked and return later.
Explain the idea aloud if spoken language helps unlock the sentence.
exit_criteria: Every planned block is represented.
No unsupported claim has been added.
The draft reaches the ask or information-only close.
prohibited_shortcuts: Polishing each sentence before completing the draft

actions: Immediately note missing development, then create distance from the draft when time allows.
Reread from the intended audience's perspective and identify the two largest weaknesses first.
Revise for truth, completeness, fairness, diplomacy, structure, evidence, and appropriate emphasis.
Edit in distinct passes for citations, tone, transitions, clarity, concision, grammar, punctuation, and typographical errors.
Check whether specifics replace vague assertions and whether the close makes the next step clear.
Allow substantial time for review rather than treating editing as a last-minute sweep.
exit_criteria: All ten passes are recorded.
Blocking evidence, action, or risk issues are resolved.
The final draft fits the surface.
prohibited_shortcuts: Making the message generic to sound professional

source_workflow_digest.loop_policy: Proceed in the stated order while allowing a later stage to return to an earlier one when a real gap appears. Preserve the distinction between generation, organization, drafting, and judgment.

required_actions: Clarify the assignment, desired result, and intended readers.
Estimate available time and allocate it across gathering, outlining, drafting, and judging.
Gather from memory, research, observation, conversations, reasoning, and tentative ideas.
Record propositions or issue labels alongside facts, data, opinions, quotations, and source locators.
Mark direct quotations and distinguish facts from opinions or speculation.
Push beyond the first obvious ideas.
exit_criteria: The purpose and audience are explicit.
Important factual support has traceable sources.
The writer has enough material to attempt complete propositions.
failure_risks: late discovery of the strongest point

stages.purpose: Turn raw material into a reader-oriented plan.
required_actions: Write the main points as complete, specific propositions.
Use about three propositions when that compression fits, without forcing the final document to contain exactly three.
Order points according to the reader's task rather than the order of discovery.
Choose an opening, middle, and close appropriate to the purpose.
Remove irrelevant branches and identify evidence gaps.
Decide whether a graphic would materially clarify the content.
exit_criteria: The reader can see the logic from the propositions alone.
Each major point has sufficient support or a flagged research gap.
The order reflects audience needs and relationship context.

stages.purpose: Produce a complete draft with momentum.
required_actions: Reduce distractions and schedule a definite drafting period.
Use the outline as a guide and begin with the most tractable section if necessary.
Draft rapidly enough to preserve flow and natural idiom.
Defer line editing and perfectionism.
Move to another section when blocked and return later.
Explain the idea aloud if spoken language helps unlock the sentence.
outputs: visible placeholders for unresolved evidence or transitions
exit_criteria: All planned sections exist in draft form.
The central case is complete enough to revise as a whole.

stages.purpose: Revise the whole and then edit its expression.
required_actions: Immediately note missing development, then create distance from the draft when time allows.
Reread from the intended audience's perspective and identify the two largest weaknesses first.
Revise for truth, completeness, fairness, diplomacy, structure, evidence, and appropriate emphasis.
Edit in distinct passes for citations, tone, transitions, clarity, concision, grammar, punctuation, and typographical errors.
Check whether specifics replace vague assertions and whether the close makes the next step clear.
Allow substantial time for review rather than treating editing as a last-minute sweep.
exit_criteria: The purpose is apparent early.
The message is complete but not padded.
Claims are accurate and supported.
Tone and formality fit the recipient and stakes.
Transitions, grammar, punctuation, and formatting support comprehension.

mandatory_gate: CARPENTER cannot start until ARCHITECT's purpose and recipient gates pass.
